title: Rooted in nature,
body:
Exia Organics began with a simple question: why should we choose between nature and results? We set out to make haircare that respects both, drawing on herbal traditions and refining each formula until it earns its place on the shelf.

Every product is handcrafted in Ghana for natural and textured hair, from the anti-dandruff herbal shampoo to the growth butter in its wood-grain jar. You order here, pay by Mobile Money, and can reach us on WhatsApp before, during and after your order.
photoAlt: The full Exia Organics range on a wooden table.
seoDescription: Exia Organics makes herbal haircare by hand in Ghana for natural and textured hair, rooted in nature and grounded in care since 2020.

promises.title: Herbal formulas
promises.body: Plant extracts and butters do the work. Every product is built around them.

promises.title: Nothing harsh
promises.body: No parabens, sulfates or synthetic fragrances, so hair keeps its natural oils.

promises.title: Cruelty-free
promises.body: Nothing we make is ever tested on animals.

promises.title: Made in Ghana
promises.body: Handcrafted at home, for the hair and climate we know best.

home.quote: Why should we choose between nature and results?
home.text: Exia Organics started with that question. We pair herbal traditions with careful formulation to make haircare that is gentle enough for every wash day and strong enough to show results.
